method: read-only source inspection; no Graph.build, Jedi business parse, or business execution

existing_sidecar.old_merge: merge_analysis_dependencies retains verified unselected records, rejects selected-crossing or broad-watch crossings

entries.read: AST-scoped expression, lexical bindings, call targets and returned body
entries.recorded: in-memory id(expr) memo/dependencies/traces; downstream specific hooks
entries.missing: generic cross-module read identity and negative namespace subscription; memo alone is not persistent

entries.read: Jedi infer/goto, mapped captured definitions and assignments, external/failed/unmapped results
entries.recorded: jedi-target for exact captured definition, including query memo/reuse hit; raw results and narrow reusable query observation
entries.missing: no-result/error/unmapped/assignment/provider namespace negative or prospective read witness; cached raw result lacks a complete exclusion proof
entries.consumed: exact jedi-target via analysis_readers; other query outcomes not complete sidecar reads

entries.read: lexical name, ordered local bindings, parent scope, decorator and import values
entries.recorded: association trace; imported target handled by import inventory; query fallback can record exact Jedi target
entries.missing: absent name/possible future binder and rebinding subscription; conditional walrus local values not a persistent reverse witness

entries.read: receiver class/module member, inherited bases, dynamic descriptor hooks, instance constructor and field effects
entries.recorded: member-lookup observed owner even on missing member; coverage trace/UNKNOWN; query fallback exact Jedi target
entries.missing: member/name-specific negative and prospective subclass/descriptor/field-write subscriptions, unknown receiver universe
entries.consumed: member-lookup via analysis_readers only for known owner module

entries.read: candidate site spellings, cached Jedi target/no-atoms/unqueried, matched arguments, receiver constructions and defaults
entries.recorded: parameter-origin only for matched actual caller; site index and component policy in memory; query exact target when present
entries.missing: considered-but-unmatched candidate/failed Jedi universe, future caller and absent argument-name membership; no complete negative candidate proof
entries.consumed: parameter-origin via analysis_readers; unmatched set not persisted

entries.read: callee direct return expressions, followed by resolve of returned values
entries.missing: prospective new callee/member target and missing return selection dependencies

entries.read: literal/copy slots and candidate writer scopes/effects
entries.recorded: container-effects for inspected modules; slot-writer-universe broad all-Python watch; value-flow exact entry subscriptions separately
entries.missing: not a universal function/field/Jedi read certificate; truncated budget fails closed
entries.consumed: analysis_readers, analysis_watchers, entry readers in prepare

minimal_slice: Instrument actual lookup/candidate decision boundaries with per-consumer-module read and negative/prospective witness records; export explicit complete/partial/truncated per unit; persist source/context-bound indexed producer and namespace/member/candidate-universe keys; make prepare query old successful and negative readers for changed/deleted/new producers, select affected consumers and reject retained cross-boundary or broad unresolved watches. No admission until independently full-equal on real fixture.
